title: carrick.check/0
description: Output of `carrick touch --json` and `carrick check --json`. Prose: docs/local-mode-output.md. Fields may be added; none is renamed or removed without notice. Readers ignore unknown fields and read an absent optional field as 'not stated', never as zero.

result.comment: Every response this schema describes is about ONE file, which is why file, repo and service are required. The session-level summary with no file (carrick#728) is a separate command and will carry its own shape here rather than relaxing this list.

file.description: The queried file, relative to the repo that owns it.

repo.description: Absolute path of that repo on this machine. repo + file is the path to open.

service.description: serviceName from carrick.json, else the repo name.

index_commit.description: Commit this service was indexed at.

indexed_at.description: RFC 3339 time the index (or the last refresh of this service) ran.

scanner_version.description: Scanner release that wrote the index.

changed_since_index.description: Files changed since index_commit: git diff --name-only plus mtime newer than the index.

stale.description: This file is one of the changed files.

deleted.description: The index holds the file and it is no longer on disk.

items.description: Routes and calls the index holds for this file, in line order.

boundary.description: ServiceBoundary for this file's service (src/boundary.rs), verbatim. Null when the index states none.

boundary_note.description: One sentence naming what a local index cannot hold at all, with the count the scan kept. Always present: a thin index must never read as 'there is no API here'.

boundary_lines.description: The boundary as the CLI prints it, line by line (boundary_note first, then the counts). Print these bytes rather than re-wording the struct.

kind.description: A route this file serves, or a call it makes.

method.description: HTTP method, GraphQL kind, or socket direction.

path.description: Route path, GraphQL field, socket event, or pub/sub topic.

source.description: fact = a deterministic pass stated it; candidate = the model's reading alone. Local mode indexes no model rows.

resolution_source.description: The wire value from the index blob (file_based_route, imported_member, model, ...). Null = not stated by this row.

evidence.description: One line naming what the row was read off.

verdict.description: Always null from touch. check fills it in where the index holds one.

role.description: peer = shared external contract: both sides call the same third party and neither serves the other.

repo.description: Absolute path of the counterpart's repo on this machine; null when the index no longer holds it.

file.description: Relative to the counterpart's OWN repo, which is a different repo from the queried file's.

state.description: The type layer's word, same vocabulary as verdict_state on the PR-result payload (carrick#727, carrick#731). resolved = a compiler verdict with no any/unknown/error on either side; unresolved = a verdict was attempted and a side would not resolve; not_checked = no type verdict bears on this row (method_mismatch, producer_removed, or nothing to compare). Never a statement about freshness: read `stale` for that.

detail.description: One line, written to be read by a model.

error.description: Exit code is 0 anyway: a read-only command never fails an edit.
